db:insert.doc:name: Insert saga_instances

db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ sagaId: vars.sagaId, orderId: vars.inboundReq.orderId, customerId: vars.inboundReq.customerId, requestPayload: write(vars.inboundReq, 'application/json'), corrId: vars.corrId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Seed Step 1
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO saga_steps (step_id, saga_id, step_sequence, step_name, step_state, compensation_state) VALUES (:stepId, :sagaId, 1, 'RESERVE_INVENTORY', 'NOT_STARTED', 'NOT_REQUIRED')

db:insert.doc:name: Seed Step 2
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO saga_steps (step_id, saga_id, step_sequence, step_name, step_state, compensation_state) VALUES (:stepId, :sagaId, 2, 'CHARGE_PAYMENT', 'NOT_STARTED', 'NOT_REQUIRED')

db:insert.doc:name: Seed Step 3

db:select.doc:name: Query Terminal State

logger.doc:name: Terminal State Reached

db:select.doc:name: Select Saga Steps
db:select.db:sql: SELECT step_sequence, step_name, step_state, attempt_count, compensation_state, failure_code, command_sent_at, reply_received_at, compensated_at FROM saga_steps WHERE saga_id = :sagaId ORDER BY step_sequence ASC

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var inst = vars.terminalSaga[0] --- { sagaId: inst.saga_id, orderId: inst.order_id, sagaState: "COMPLETED", message: "Order fulfilled and all saga steps completed successfully.", correlationId: vars.corrId, steps: (vars.stepRows default []) map (row) -> { stepSequence: row.step_sequence, stepName: row.step_name, stepState: row.step_state, attemptCount: row.attempt_count, compensationState: row.compensation_state, startedAt: row.command_sent_at as String default null, completedAt: row.reply_received_at as String default null } }

db:select.doc:name: Select Saga Steps

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var inst = vars.terminalSaga[0] var code = inst.failure_code default "ORDER_FULFILMENT_FAILED" var msg = inst.failure_message default "Saga execution failed and compensating actions were executed." --- { errorCode: code, message: msg, sagaId: inst.saga_id, orderId: inst.order_id, sagaState: inst.saga_state, failureCode: code, failureMessage: msg, correlationId: vars.corrId, steps: (vars.stepRows default []) map (row) -> { stepSequence: row.step_sequence, stepName: row.step_name, stepState: row.step_state, attemptCount: row.attempt_count, compensationState: row.compensation_state, (failureCode: row.failure_code) if (!isEmpty(row.failure_code default '')), startedAt: row.command_sent_at as String default null, completedAt: row.reply_received_at as String default null, compensatedAt: row.compensated_at as String default null } }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sagaId: vars.sagaId, orderId: vars.inboundReq.orderId, sagaState: "STEP_IN_PROGRESS", statusUrl: "/api/v1/sagas/" ++ vars.sagaId, correlationId: vars.corrId }

logger.message: #['[CRITICAL_DLQ_ALERT] Poison/Failed saga message received from DLQ: sagaId=' ++ (vars.dlqMessage.sagaId default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ', correlationId=' ++ (vars.dlqMessage.correlationId default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ', event=' ++ (vars.dlqMessage.event default '')]

db:update.doc:name: Audit DLQ Receipt in Database
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_instances SET failure_code = 'DLQ_POISON_MESSAGE', failure_message = :failMsg WHERE saga_id = :sagaId

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Audited
logger.message: #['[DLQ_AUDIT_COMPLETE] Successfully audited DLQ message for saga: ' ++ (vars.dlqMessage.sagaId default '')]

db:select.doc:name: Find Timed-out Steps
db:select.db:sql: SELECT s.step_id, s.saga_id, s.step_sequence, s.step_name FROM saga_steps s JOIN saga_instances i ON s.saga_id = i.saga_id WHERE s.step_state = 'STEP_IN_PROGRESS' AND s.timeout_at IS NOT NULL AND s.timeout_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND i.saga_state = 'STEP_IN_PROGRESS' LIMIT 5

logger.doc:name: Log Timeout
logger.message: #['[SAGA_STEP_TIMEOUT] Step ' ++ (vars.timeoutStep.step_name default '') ++ ' timed out for saga: ' ++ (vars.timeoutStep.saga_id default '') ++ '. Initiating backward compensation.']

db:update.doc:name: Mark Step FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_steps SET step_state = 'FAILED', failure_code = 'STEP_TIMEOUT', reply_received_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE step_id = :stepId AND step_state = 'STEP_IN_PROGRESS'

when.expression: #[((if (vars.stepTimeoutResult is Number) vars.stepTimeoutResult else vars.stepTimeoutResult.affectedRows) default 0) > 0]

db:update.doc:name: Mark Saga COMPENSATING
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_instances SET saga_state = 'COMPENSATING', failure_code = 'STEP_TIMEOUT', failure_message = 'Step execution timed out without reply' WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND saga_state = 'STEP_IN_PROGRESS'

db:update.doc:name: Mark Saga COMPENSATED Immediately
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_instances SET saga_state = 'COMPENSATED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND saga_state = 'COMPENSATING'

db:select.doc:name: Find Stuck Sagas
db:select.db:sql: SELECT saga_id, order_id, saga_state, current_step, started_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS elapsed_seconds FROM saga_instances WHERE saga_state IN ('STARTED', 'STEP_IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPENSATING') AND started_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -:thresholdSec, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 10

logger.doc:name: Log Stuck Saga Alert
logger.message: #['[STUCK_SAGA_ALERT] Alert: Saga stuck! sagaId=' ++ (payload.saga_id default '') ++ ', orderId=' ++ (payload.order_id default '') ++ ', state=' ++ (payload.saga_state default '') ++ ', step=' ++ (payload.current_step default '') ++ ', elapsedSeconds=' ++ (payload.elapsed_seconds default '')]
